author: Alec Steele
description:
Crimson Desert is out now to play on PC, PS5 and Xbox series X/S - Click the link here: https://pearlabyss.info/CrimsonDesertAlecSteele Thank you to Crimson Desert for Sponsoring the video! 
We forged a Wolf's Head for the pommel of Grey Wolf's sword. So much fun! It turns out it's meant to be a one-handed sword... In my enthusiasm, I made it into a monster two handed beast of a blade! 

ABANA’s animal head forging videos with Darryl Nelson were a great starting point for trying to forge this wolf’s head: https://youtu.be/o5VN-PJmprQ?si=PrPqX2ZYPK-ijoDM
